title: Inspect and extend: Embed a web page inside a SwiftUI screen
objective: Use the real implementation in `Sources/WebView.swift` to demonstrate and safely improve uiviewrepresentable/webkit bridge, navigation state, and page loading.
problem: SwiftUI draws the controls; WebKit renders the actual webpage. Read the wrapper boundary and trace URL changes from browser state into WKWebView. Your implementation or debugging result must remain consistent with the source architecture.
requirements: Read `Sources/WebView.swift` and the related project files: Sources/WebView.swift; Sources/Screens/BrowseView.swift.
Add or improve a focused behavior related to uiviewrepresentable/webkit bridge, navigation state, and page loading.
Add a meaningful unit test or, when platform tooling is unavailable, document a reproducible manual check.
Update documentation to identify local, simulated, external, and missing behavior accurately.
constraints: Do not claim or implement as complete a capability outside this boundary: This is an educational WebKit wrapper, not a custom browser engine or hardened production browser.
Do not add credentials, personal records, real funds, or unsafe public network exposure.
Keep the change within the existing project architecture and name any new dependencies.
expected_behavior: SwiftUI draws the controls; WebKit renders the actual webpage. Read the wrapper boundary and trace URL changes from browser state into WKWebView.
acceptance_criteria: The implementation change is traceable to `Sources/WebView.swift`.
Normal and failure/edge cases are described and tested.
The test outcome and environment are recorded honestly.
README or source comments correctly state remaining limitations.
hints: Read the caller and the closest existing test before editing.
Separate a pure rule test from any UI, device, provider, or network test.
